author: xmalito31
quote: As a lifelong Zelda fan who has played Ocarina of Time, Majora's Mask, Twilight Princess, Breath of the Wild, and Tears of the Kingdom, this remake is pure perfection. From the breathtaking title screen to the beautiful landscapes, enchanting music, and unforgettable ocarina melodies, everything feels crafted with love. It's nostalgia, poetry, beauty, art, and emotion combined. A game that makes you think, reflect, and feel. I wouldn't change a thing. An absolute masterpiece. 100/100.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: xmalito31
quote: As a longtime GTA fan since the original game, I feel GTA VI has lost its essence. Rockstar prioritized realism and stunning graphics over fun and performance. Sacrificing 60 FPS for 30 FPS feels like a generational downgrade. Movement, driving, and controls feel unnecessarily slow and heavy. GTA should entertain, not become a life simulator. More realism doesn't always mean better gameplay. Technically impressive, but disappointing as a Grand Theft Auto experience.
